scope: Exact 24-scene physical TRAIN_C5_24 cohort only; canonical IDs have DEV prefix and are in-sample for the frozen parent model.
purpose: Screen one shared fixed four-notch bank on final applied C5 position compensation while retaining the parent cosine-GRU attitude arm; no added position residual GRU.

filter.type: four causal unity-DC biquad notches, cascaded in ascending listed order
filter.application_point: final held applied position-compensation acceleration, after frozen C5 action and before conversion to injected force
filter.update_rule: Only at the logged 100-Hz position events; zero-order hold between events
filter.state_initialization: At the first nonzero action event, initialize every section's input/output history to that current action and pass it unchanged

frequency_source.use: offline TRAIN24 group reporting only; fixed bank is identical for all 24 scenes

frozen_replay_metrics.target_definition: Reconstruct logged command_filter_target_euler from commanded force; replay replaces only the final applied compensation, retaining logged yaw and nominal force
frozen_replay_metrics.low_frequency_amplitude: Per-scene action and command-target RMS before/after plus RMS delta percentage
frozen_replay_metrics.low_frequency_phase: Exact cascade response phase/equivalent delay and numeric group delay over 0.05-0.5 Hz; point response at 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.45, 0.50 Hz
frozen_replay_metrics.wind_group_target_bands: For each nonzero TRAIN24 wind group's fixed measured f1/f2, command-target and action vector RMS in center +/-0.10-Hz windows; report each scene and group median/range
frozen_replay_metrics.zero_wind_group: W15 has no configured tone bands; report the fixed 0.05-10-Hz command-target RMS change
additional_outputs: force-chain and baseline command reconstruction residuals

predeclared_risk_flags_not_pass_gates.rationale: 2% reuses the prior frozen low-band screen; 10 ms is one 100-Hz filter update interval.
predeclared_risk_flags_not_pass_gates.also_flag: Any scene/group wind-tone command-target band whose RMS increases; report as counterevidence without tuning.

interpretation_limit: Frozen same-trajectory TRAIN replay only; no closed-loop actual-attitude/position prediction and no cross-wind generalization claim.
